stem: In the figure, triangle \(ABC\) is equilateral, and \(\overline{AD}\) bisects angle \(BAC\). What is the measure, in degrees, of angle \(BAD\)?
solution: Each angle of an equilateral triangle measures \(\frac{180}{3} = 60^{\circ}\), so angle \(BAC = 60^{\circ}\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(d('A','B')-d('B','C'))<0.01 and abs(d('B','C')-d('C','A'))<0.01
assert abs(ang('B','A','D')-ang('D','A','C'))<0.1
ans=Rational(180,3)/2
assert abs(ang('B','A','D')-ans)<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans==30
